classRulings.abstractDet: Two settings of one papyrus roll: Y1a when the roll stands upright (tall rectangle with tie on its side: ṭua, àau, maā, qemau, reχu, reχ-tu, uṭen, àmen, qem, āāaiu, māχa, śeta l.5); Y1 when it lies flat with the tie on top (under Z9 in śeta, χet, maāt, ḥesb, χeri). N16 never occurs as this determinative (no grains under the bar).
classRulings.lowFlat: U15 (sledge): flat runner with upcurled hooked left end and an upright tab at the right end, no stick and no hand; differs from the D36 of āāui/ḥenā (plain left end). Applies to seχem, ḥebs-nà, ḥau, χer-sek, θesu. Caveat: by sense these words usually take D40, but the type shows no stick.
classRulings.iNaReed: M18 (reed with walking legs) as first sign of ī - nà, then plain M17.
classRulings.give: D37 (forearm holding conical loaf) in ṭā - f, ṭā - nà, erṭā - nà.
classRulings.em: Aa15 for the preposition em (bevelled, open at right); Aa11 only for the closed plinth in maā/maāχeru.
classRulings.tSign: The rod/spike opening t'eṭet - à is coded U28 (t'), not U33 or D46.
classRulings.transliteration: iu (p.190 l.6), an (p.193 l.20, possibly broken àn), neśemet, erṭā - nà.
classRulings.fourStrokes: Four strokes under N35 coded Z2+Z1.
